files_in_data_dir

# Load the dataset
data_path = os.path.join(data_folder_path, 'dataset.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(data_path)

# Display the first few rows and the info of the dataframe
df_info = df.info()
df_head = df.head()

df_info, df_head

# Convert 'purchase_date' to datetime format
df['purchase_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['purchase_date'])

# Aggregate total revenue by month
monthly_revenue = df.resample('M', on='purchase_date')['total_spent'].sum().reset_index()

# Display the aggregated monthly revenue
monthly_revenue.head()

# Check for missing values in the monthly revenue data
missing_values = monthly_revenue.isnull().sum()
missing_values

import statsmodels.api as sm

# Set the purchase_date as the index
monthly_revenue.set_index('purchase_date', inplace=True)

# Perform seasonal decomposition
decomposition = sm.tsa.seasonal_decompose(monthly_revenue['total_spent'], model='additive')

# Plot the decomposition
decomposition.plot()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Plot the monthly revenue
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(monthly_revenue.index, monthly_revenue['total_spent'], marker='o')
plt.title('Monthly Revenue Over Time')
plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Total Revenue')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid()
plt.show()
